title: Fixed Arched T Head and Long Grip Razor
description: One newly authored complete fixed T-head razor-style exterior. A whole long contoured grip with rounded heel and a narrow accent collar joins a short neck and a full transverse guard plate. Two genuine long slots separate its continuous blunt outer guard rails from the central plate. One whole finite-thickness barrel-arched cap sits above, attached by a hidden central stud, with visible long side separation. No thin sharp blade or edge is provided. Unlike the broad palm hair clipper with toothed comb or the long fork with one circular cutter wheel, this is a complete axial grip and crosswise double-edge-style head relationship. All geometry original, three opaque materials, one prop zero scenes. Static grooming-tool appearance only: no person, skin contact, shaving, disassembly, blade fitting, cutting, mechanism, ergonomic, hygiene or safety performance. Rigging animation interaction not made.
